title: reflexive-friedmann-system
description: RFS: couples disequilibrium order parameter g(z) into a generalized Friedmann equation via reflexive-energy Ω_g g²(z). g(z) obeys Landau flow dg/dz=-A(z)g-Bg³, A(z)=β[Ω_m(1+z)³-Ω_Λ] sign-changing at z_c (matter–Λ equality). ρ_g is a candidate new cosmos-cell entering via cosmogenerating pending empirical correspondence.
